hero_title: Merge JW Library backups privately in your browser
hero_desc: Studied on your phone and your tablet? Restoring either backup deletes the other's notes — merging is the only way to keep both. Then organise, search and share the library you already have, entirely in your browser.
feat_local_desc: All merging happens in your browser via WebAssembly. No server. No uploads. Complete privacy.
feat_tags_desc: Rename a tag across 300 notes, merge duplicates, bulk retag and recolour. JW Library has no bulk editing at all.
feat_date_desc: Pull out a service year, a convention or one study project as its own backup, without disturbing your main library.
feat_browse_desc: Search your whole library by keyword — or by meaning, describing the note you only half remember. Edit, retag and recolour, then download the updated backup.
feat_review_desc: See exactly which notes were edited on more than one device and choose which version wins — no black box.
footer_tagline: JW Sync processes all data locally — your files never leave your device.
svc_merge_d: Combine backups from two devices without either one overwriting the other.
svc_explorer_d: Search, edit and bulk-retag every note — including finding one by describing it when the words escape you.
svc_stats_d: See your study streaks, totals and trends over time.
svc_share_d: Send a friend just the notes under one tag, or from one date range, without touching anything they wrote.
svc_doctor_d: Free health check — find and fix duplicates, empty notes and clutter.
svc_reading_d: Follow a daily Bible reading plan — with your own notes beside you.
meta_title: JW Sync — Merge JW Library backups privately in your browser
meta_desc: Merge JW Library backups from two devices without either overwriting the other — plus bulk tag editing, note search by meaning, and selective note sharing. Free, in your browser.
